findings.observation: Skin tone, hooded-eye direction, broken brow, small upturned nose, heavy lower lip, and chestnut color remain related, but the summon’s compact square adult face becomes a rounder, pointed-chin, oversized-eye doll template with weakened adult jaw and cheek specificity.
The compact combat body retains Eira’s broad shoulders, sturdy torso, substantial hips and legs, and grounded medium-height posture without a generic increase in body fat or muscle.
The source’s long relaxed hands and proportional wrists become enlarged padded hands with compressed fingers, especially the viewer-right hand, creating generic chibi limb inflation.
The swept part and brown-chestnut waves remain related, but the source’s controlled shoulder-length medium-loose silhouette inflates into a much wider and longer mass extending well down the torso.

The teal-brown tailored longcoat, architectural lapel, rolled sleeves, plain underlayer, repairs, split hem, trousers, and fitted shoes remain recognizable, but the summon’s visible wooden thread gauge and dangling threads are omitted rather than preserved at chibi scale.
Visual measurement places the complete hair-top-to-chin unit at about 31 percent of standing height, approximately 3.2 heads tall, below the strict 32–36 percent / 2.75–3.1 lock.

Exactly one complete figure is shown with all inflated hair, the full head, both empty hands, both coat tails, both legs, both fitted shoes, and the grounding shadow inside generous parchment margins.
The planted three-quarter ready-idle stance, separated empty hands, large chestnut silhouette, teal repaired longcoat, split hem, and fitted shoes remain clear at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The repaired cloth coat, plain underlayer, work trousers, and shoes remain grounded mortal clothing; no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.
